Model summary for an mvgam fit

Source: R/tidier_methods.R
glance.mvgam.Rd

broom-style summary of an mvgam fit, one row per response. Reports the Stan algorithm, post-warmup sample size, training-observation count, response family, link function and (optionally) loo criteria. Mirrors broom.mixed::glance.brmsfit().

Usage

# S3 method for class 'mvgam'
glance(x, looic = FALSE, resp = NULL, ...)

Arguments

x

A fitted mvgam object.

looic

Logical. If TRUE, compute leave-one-out information criteria via loo.mvgam() and add elpd_loo, se_elpd_loo, p_loo and looic columns. Defaults to FALSE because computing loo can be slow on large fits.

resp

Character specifying which response variable for multivariate models. NULL (default) returns predictions for all responses.

...

Forwarded to loo.mvgam() when looic = TRUE.

Value

A tibble with one row, or on a multivariate fit given no resp one row per response with a resp column. Columns:

  • algorithm – the algorithm the fit ran, such as "sampling" or "meanfield".

  • pss – post-warmup sample size summed across chains.

  • nobs – number of (non-missing) training observations.

  • nseries – number of unique series in the training data.

  • family – observation-family name.

  • link – observation-family link.

  • Optional: elpd_loo, se_elpd_loo, p_loo, looic (only when looic = TRUE).

See also

tidy.mvgam(), augment.mvgam(), loo.mvgam()

Other tidiers: augment.mvgam(), tidy.mvgam()

Examples

# \dontrun{
# A Poisson GAM without a latent trend. PSIS approximates each
# held-out count of such a model well (see Details of ?loo.mvgam)
set.seed(13)
simdat <- sim_mvgam(family = poisson(), n_series = 1L,
                    n_timepoints = 120L, trend_model = "None")
mod <- mvgam(y ~ s(x), data = simdat$data_train,
             family = poisson(), chains = 2, silent = 2)
#> Warning: 2 of 2000 (0.0%) transitions ended with a divergence.
#> See https://mc-stan.org/misc/warnings for details.
# }
# \dontrun{
# The sampler and data dimensions of the fit, in one row
glance(mod)
#> # A tibble: 1 × 6
#>   algorithm   pss  nobs nseries family  link 
#>   <chr>     <int> <int>   <int> <chr>   <chr>
#> 1 sampling   2000    90       1 poisson log  

# Leave-one-out criteria take longer to compute
glance(mod, looic = TRUE)
#> # A tibble: 1 × 10
#>   algorithm   pss  nobs nseries family  link  elpd_loo se_elpd_loo p_loo looic
#>   <chr>     <int> <int>   <int> <chr>   <chr>    <dbl>       <dbl> <dbl> <dbl>
#> 1 sampling   2000    90       1 poisson log      -209.        8.48  7.98  418.
# }
